skin.label: Visual skin
skin.description: Visual language only; colors and fonts always come from the active --ipw-* theme.

camera.label: Camera
camera.description: Camera move with enter, hold drift and exit phases on the composition timeline.

motionCueTimes.label: Semantic cue times
motionCueTimes.description: JSON event IDs to measured scene-relative seconds. Empty uses content-paced defaults; this is not word alignment.

fallback.overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or choose a sparser business diagram; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
fallback.missingInput: Resolve the actual required input or report the missing content; do not substitute demo defaults.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once in order; keep authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary instead of stretching speech.
fallback.inapplicable: Choose another business diagram or registry recipe whose structure matches the content, split the content, or report the gap.

inputRules.skin: keynote for calm launches, cinematic for dark stages, editorial for print-like explainers, dot for hardware/AI moods; colours still follow --ipw-*.
inputRules.camera: flat by default; tilt, iso, unfold or dolly only when depth helps the story. The camera enters, drifts while held and exits with the scene.

blocks.name: biz-mindmap
blocks.title: Business Mind Map
blocks.description: A central topic radiating into 2–6 branches, each revealed with its points as the narration reaches it.

variables.label: Branches (label@icon::point, point | ...)
variables.default: 教@cap::备课助手,课件生成,分层教学|学@book::个性化路径,苏格拉底式答疑,错题本,口语陪练|评@check::自动批改,能力画像,过程性评价|管@chart::学情看板,资源调度

events.action: Establish the central topic
Grow the first branch from the centre and attach its points
Grow this branch and attach its points while earlier branches step back
Grow this branch and attach its points while earlier branches step back
Grow this branch and attach its points while earlier branches step back
Grow this branch and attach its points while earlier branches step back
Grow this branch and attach its points while earlier branches step back
Bring every branch back to the complete readable map

usage.intent: 围绕一个主题向外发散，按旁白逐支展开，让观众看到全貌而不是一次性信息轰炸。
useWhen: Explore one topic through 2–6 associated themes with a few short points each.
avoidWhen: Do not use for reporting lines, ordered steps or dependencies; branch position and length carry no quantity.

inputRules.center: The real topic in at most 12 CJK characters; optional @icon suffix.
inputRules.branches: 2–6 entries separated by "|": label@icon::point, point. Labels ≤ 8 CJK characters, 0–5 points of ≤ 10 CJK characters each.
inputRules.highlight: 1-based branch index to emphasise, or 0 for none.
inputRules.reveal: branch for narrated walkthroughs, level for overviews, all for a static map.
inputRules.centerSub: Optional short subtitle under the topic, ≤ 32 characters; Latin text renders as small caps.

readingOrder: Follow each branch and its points

cueBindings.center: When narration names the topic, establish the centre.
cueBindings.step-1: When narration reaches branch 1, grow it and attach its points.
cueBindings.step-2: When narration reaches branch 2, grow it and attach its points.
cueBindings.step-3: When narration reaches branch 3, grow it and attach its points.
cueBindings.step-4: When narration reaches branch 4, grow it and attach its points.
cueBindings.step-5: When narration reaches branch 5, grow it and attach its points.
cueBindings.step-6: When narration reaches branch 6, grow it and attach its points.
cueBindings.resolve: At the concluding clause, restore the whole map; keep the final reading hold.

values.branches: 教@cap::备课助手,课件生成|学@book::个性化路径,错题本|评@check::自动批改,能力画像

example.narration: AI 进入教育后，首先改变的是教，其次是学，最后是评。

acceptance: Every active branch event reveals its branch and points; forward and backward seeking restore the same state.
Inactive capacity slots acquire no cue and render nothing.
The final state shows every branch readable without overlap, in the active --ipw-* theme.
Test Chinese content with 2 and 6 branches, and reject a seventh branch.

usage.intent: 沿真实时间顺序把里程碑一个个落在轨道上，并标出“现在走到哪”。
useWhen: Show 3–8 dated milestones in genuine chronological order, optionally marking the current one.
avoidWhen: Do not invent dates or imply duration from spacing; use a roadmap when intervals must be measured.

inputRules.items: 3–8 entries separated by "|": date::title@icon::detail. Title ≤ 10 CJK characters, detail ≤ 18 CJK characters.
inputRules.current: 1-based index of the current milestone, or 0 for none.

readingOrder: See the whole journey and the current point

Dates stay exactly as supplied; spacing is never presented as duration.

blocks.name: biz-system-architecture

blocks.description: Layered system architecture that folds into an isometric plane, builds layer by layer and then lights the cross-layer flow.

usage.intent: 把系统按层搭起来，再点亮跨层调用路径，让观众理解“请求怎样穿过系统”。
useWhen: Explain a layered software or platform architecture with 2–5 layers and the calls between them.
avoidWhen: Do not mix deployment topology or message timing into the layers; use a sequence for ordered calls.

inputRules.layers: 2–5 entries top to bottom separated by "|": label@icon::node@icon, node. 1–5 nodes per layer, ≤ 12 characters each.
inputRules.links: Comma-separated from>to pairs using exact node labels; omit to show layers only.
inputRules.emphasis: Comma-separated layer or node labels that form the featured path.

readingOrder: See the layers form one by one

cueBindings.step-1: When narration reaches layer 1, build it.
cueBindings.step-2: When narration reaches layer 2, build it.
cueBindings.step-3: When narration reaches layer 3, build it.
cueBindings.step-4: When narration reaches layer 4, build it.
cueBindings.step-5: When narration reaches layer 5, build it.
cueBindings.resolve: When narration explains how a request travels, draw the links and show the whole architecture.

values.layers: 接入层@globe::Web,App|服务层@server::Agent 编排|模型层@brain::教育大模型
values.links: Web>Agent 编排,Agent 编排>教育大模型

example.narration: 请求从网页和 App 进来，经过 Agent 编排，最后交给教育大模型。

acceptance: Every active layer event builds its layer; forward and backward seeking restore the same state.
Links only connect labels that exist in the layers.
The final isometric state keeps every label readable inside the stage.
Test Chinese content with 2 and 5 layers, and reject a sixth layer.
